title: UserDesignPreferenceProfile
description: Learned, per-user design taste. Stage 5 of the pipeline (preference learning). Biases candidate generation and re-ranks scored candidates so results converge toward what THIS user tends to like — without any remote model. Built from implicit signals (chosen/purchased), explicit signals (like/dislike), and studio-labelled references. Stored per user (Drift locally, optionally mirrored to Firestore as derived metadata).

sampleCount.description: How many feedback events have shaped this profile. Low counts → fall back to persona/global priors (cold start).

featureWeights.description: Learned multiplicative biases over categorical genes, in roughly [0.25, 4.0] (1.0 = neutral). Applied as priors in candidate generation and as a re-rank term after scoring. Keys mirror the grammar's gene space; absent keys are neutral.

scorerWeightOverrides.description: Optional per-user overrides of the DesignScore aggregate weights (aesthetic / profileFit / printabilityMargin). Clamped and normalised at load; defaults come from config/engine_config.json.

personaAffinity.description: Soft affinity toward each TravelPersona's design priors, learned from behaviour and blended with the analysed persona.

explorationRate.description: Epsilon: probability the engine deliberately shows an off-profile design to keep discovering taste and avoid collapse. Decays as sampleCount grows.

signals.description: Rolling recent feedback the weights were derived from. Bounded lists (keep newest N); recipeIds reference DesignRecipe.recipeId.

chosen.description: Implicit positive: taken into the editor / saved to cart.

dismissed.description: Implicit weak negative: shown then skipped.
